description: Migrate egress traffic from direct internet access to a centralized egress proxy (squid/Nginx) for compliance. Must: deploy egress proxy in a dedicated VPC, configure NAT Gateway routing through the proxy, set up dual-egress (old direct + new proxy) during migration, cutover application traffic to proxy in batches, verify all traffic flows through proxy, and enforce egress allowlist rules. Risk factors: proxy becoming a single point of failure, allowlist too restrictive breaking services, latency increase from proxy inspection, DNS resolution issues. Tools available: terraform, squid, nginx, aws CLI, ansible.
